author: Hermes
question: A 12 ohm and a 6 ohm resistor are connected in parallel across an ideal 24 V DC source. How much power is dissipated in the 6 ohm resistor?
solution: In parallel both resistors see the full 24 V. Power in 6 ohm = V^2/R = 24 x 24/6 = 576/6 = 96 W. Topic (network elements, power) is in Section 2 of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Electric Circuits
